summary: Enable cross-tenant Slack guest access for Platform Payments pod; create Jira project skeleton and sync Confluence docs with read-only guest view; apply 90d message retention and approval workflow
description:
Issue summary:
Request to enable timebound cross-tenant Slack guest access for an external payments partner on the Platform Payments pod. In addition to Slack guest provisioning we need a matching Jira project skeleton (kanban board, default issue types, labels) and a Confluence space with a read-only view for guests. Finally apply a 90-day message retention policy on the provisioned channels and wire an approval workflow (manager -> security) that triggers guest provisioning.

Impact:
- Platform Payments team needs to onboard vendor engineers for a 6-week integration window.
- Without a standardized onboarding flow, manual provisioning is slowing down partner work and introduces inconsistent permissions.

Environment:
- Redwood prod workspace, global Slack workspace (org-wide guest model), Confluence Standard tier, Jira internal projects.

Request details / Acceptance criteria:
1) Create a timebound Slack guest template: channel list (#payments-integration, #payments-oncall-readonly), limited message/post permissions, 30-day auto-expire with optional 1x extension.
2) Create a Jira project skeleton (key: PAYINT) with Kanban board, issue types: Task, Bug, Spike, Subtask; default labels: payments, partner, integration. Template should be clonable for future partners.
3) Create Confluence space (Payments Integration) seeded with integration runbook and API keys handling doc; set space permissions to read-only for guest group and editors restricted to Platform Payments leads.
4) Enforce 90-day retention for Slack messages in the provisioned channels; confirm retention policy does not affect Confluence pages.
5) Implement a lightweight approval automation: Submitter triggers a form -> sends approval request to Platform Payments manager and Security reviewer; on approval, provisioning bot creates guest accounts (with timebound membership), applies channel permissions, creates the Jira project skeleton, and links the Confluence space.
6) Provide a one-click deprovision runbook (Slack revoke, Jira project archive steps, Confluence access remove).

Constraints & Notes:
- Must follow existing org security guardrails: guests cannot access private HR/legal channels; SSO enforced.
- Any automation needs to emit audit events to the central audit Confluence/Jira index.
- Contact Platform Payments lead (Cameron Wright) for channel naming and reviewer list.

Steps to reproduce / action items:
- [ ] Security to confirm guest permission set and KBA for external users.
- [ ] Trust & SSO team to enable cross-tenant guest invites and timebound auto-expiry.
- [ ] Automation team to create provisioning workflow (use existing onboarding bot if possible).
- [ ] Docs owner to seed Confluence space and mark pages as read-only for guests.
- [ ] Platform Payments to validate and approve on staging before prod run.
